reason.message: The edge node reports state AVAILABLE with qwen36-27b loaded, so it can answer with no load step. prefer-warm-local sets warm_preference: strict, which means any warm candidate beats any cold one regardless of prefer_order - the edge wins both on warmth and on being first in prefer_order here, but the warm rule is what would decide it even if the order were reversed.

Eligible, second in prefer_order, and not known to be warm - KServe is never probed, so its readiness is unknown rather than warm or cold by construction. A strict warm preference outranks order regardless.
